summary: Dependency-confusion probe beacons host/install metadata to hardcoded VPS on install and require
details: Package ships a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and a main entry (index.js) that both invoke a `fire()` routine which POSTs `os.hostname()`, `__dirname`, `process.cwd()`, node/npm versions, and the package name to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS certificate validation disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The destination is a bare Contabo VPS unrelated to any declared publisher. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy whose every property is a no-op; the package has no library functionality beyond the callback. An in-source comment frames a successful load as 'proof' that the package landed on a build host, consistent with a dependency-confusion / internal-scope takeover probe under the `@c1-ease` scope. The beacon fires both at `npm install` (lifecycle script) and whenever a consumer `require`s the module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
